summary: IDS feed s098_single is degraded: 86.5% of bytes are encrypted, exceeding the IDS tolerance of 60%. No duplicates, drops, overload, one-way or VLAN issues detected.

findings.root_cause: 86.5% of bytes are encrypted (TLS/SSL) vs 60% maximum for this IDS. Traffic is being delivered without decryption or SSL visibility at the packet broker, so payload remains opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection. With 86% encrypted, it cannot inspect application content, causing missed exploit, malware and C2 detections and severely reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: IDS cannot analyze encrypted payloads. Provide selective TLS decryption via packet broker SSL visibility/decryption zone or feed a decrypted copy, while respecting privacy/policy, to restore payload visibility and detection efficacy.
